name: チームフォルダーから継承したアクセス権行
prompt:
Recreate only the supplied Dropbox inherited-permission row as a faithful Japanese localization. The exact crop is 576x99 pixels (5.82:1), a short, wide, compact access row. Preserve the full horizontal row proportions and do not add the surrounding permission dialog, page background beyond the crop, other users, or extra controls.

On a very light neutral background, keep the subtle thin border and rounded row container from the crop. At the far left, show the same small outlined team-folder icon in its square light-gray tile. To its right, place the main label 「ASMobbin の全員」 in dark gray, with the smaller muted subtitle 「2人のメンバー」 directly below. Align the permission selector at the far right: 「編集可能」 in dark text followed by a small downward caret. Maintain the source's broad empty space between the group information and the right-aligned permission selector.

Use compact readable system sans-serif typography, subtle gray borders, restrained colors, and the source's small left/right padding and vertical centering. No avatar, extra row, selected state, checkmark, or additional labels. Use the supplied crop as authority for the icon, hierarchy, alignment, and spacing. Keep the target aspect ratio 576x99 (5.82:1), with no large blank bands.
reviewNotes: v001 includes the team-folder icon, ASMobbin group label, 2-member subtitle and edit-permission dropdown. It is 2142x734 (2.92:1) versus the 576x99 (5.82:1) source, with excess canvas whitespace and a taller inset row. Earlier 4.84:1, 10.48:1 and 12.96:1 items also failed to hold their wide ratios; recorded needs-correction after one attempt.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
